text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school, Matikanetannhauser
cheerfully came over to talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it turns out I'll be going
back to my parents' house on my next day off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It happens every time, but whenever I go back,
they throw a celebration party at my family's diner~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A mountain of mixed deep-fried goodies made by Mom and Dad...
That moment of stuffing my cheeks with it...♪
choice_data_list: Make sure to eat plenty, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A mountain of mixed deep-fried goodies made by Mom and Dad...
That moment of stuffing my cheeks with it...♪
choice_data_list: Make sure to eat plenty, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hau?! Don't call me out like that!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right... Sigh...
I'm a proper athlete now, so I can't just go
eating whatever without thinking about the consequences...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Understood, I'll let my parents know in advance not to make too much.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Is there really no chance
that deep-fried horse mackerel would be fine...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we managed to keep Matikane Tannhauser from overeating.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll be sure to savor home cooking after so long!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me, plump fried shrimp!
Juicy, sizzling pork cutlet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Matikane Tannhauser made sure to get plenty of nourishment while visiting home.
